column1: # MongoDB Shell (mongosh) token forms for generated compat rows: the text
# written for each terminal class in MongoShell.g4. Keywords, method names, and
# punctuation are literals in the grammar and need no row. Sources:
#   ECMAScript / mongosh lexical tokens (identifiers, strings, numbers, regexes,
# A sample of one name, string, number, or $-variable stands for its class when
# the docs recognizer reads a statement.

column3: identifier (ASCII letter, _, or Unicode letter followed by letters, digits, _, $)
string literal (single-quoted so the shared recognizer lexes it as a string class; mongosh accepts single and double quotes)
numeric literal (integer, float, hex, or scientific notation)
negative numeric literal (mongosh lexes leading '-' immediately before digits as one signed number)
$-prefixed MongoDB operator or field path key in a document literal
